sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Similarly, through studying and disseminating the concept of continuous creation, which is central to Chassidus, we hasten the future redemption, which will bring a truly new Torah.

translations.translation: And similarly, on the other hand,
that through the study and dissemination of the concept of the renewal of creation every moment,
which is among the primary concepts of the Torah of Chassidus,
through this we bring closer and hasten the future redemption,
for then there will be the true renewal in Torah,
“A new Torah from Me shall go forth.”
And it can be said,
that this is also the connection of the beginning of the Torah with the beginning of the Giving of the Torah,
for the beginning of the Torah is “In the beginning, G-d created the heavens and the earth,”

and from this we come to “And G-d spoke all these words…” to the beginning of the Giving of the Torah, “I am the L-rd your G-d Who took you out of the land of Egypt,” in which is also included the future redemption, “as in the days of your exodus from the land of Egypt I will show him wonders.”
And similarly, it is in the Mishneh Torah
(of the Rambam)

that the beginning is that there is a First Existent, and He brings into existence every existent, and all existents—heavens, earth, and what is between them—only exist due to the truth of His existence.
[For it can be said that “heavens, earth, and what is between them” is analogous to “the heavens and the earth,”
“the heavens” to include the hosts of heaven, and “the earth” to include the hosts of the earth],
and from this we come to the conclusion of the Mishneh Torah—the matter of redemption,
and up to the conclusion and seal of the Mishneh Torah
— “For the earth will be filled with knowledge of the L-rd as the waters cover the sea.”

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Through our actions and service, especially the preparations for receiving the Torah after completing the Omer count, the redemption will come immediately, with the perfection of the kingdom of Dovid, Moshe, the Baal Shem Tov, and all subsequent leaders.

translations.translation: And through our deeds and our service,
and particularly in the preparations for the Giving of the Torah and the receiving of the Torah,
and particularly after we have already completed the Counting of the Omer and refined all the attributes from Chesed shebeChesed to Malchus shebeMalchus,
for the Counting of the Omer is a preparation for the Giving of the Torah, which begins with “I am [the L-rd your G-d] Who took you out of the land of Egypt”
(the matter of redemption),

and particularly in the continuation after the Omer count we say “Upon us is to praise…” until the conclusion, “And the L-rd shall be King over all the earth; on that day the L-rd shall be One and His Name One,”
[for the matter of “And the L-rd shall be King over all the earth” relates to the Sefirah of Malchus, and specifically Malchus shebeMalchus],
and after this we say, “But the righteous will give thanks to Your Name; the upright will dwell in Your presence,”
and all this was proclaimed in public, in a place where they magnify Torah and magnify prayer,
then certainly the redemption will come immediately,
and there will be the perfection of Malchus—the kingdom of the House of Dovid,
and also the kingdom of Moshe,
and likewise of the Baal Shem Tov and of all the Nesiim who followed him,
and “for whom are the kings? The Rabbis,”
and all this will be immediately,
for it will not be delayed even for the blink of an eye,
and out of joy and goodness of heart,
and below ten handbreadths,
and immediately, right now.
